corrected_fields.summary: VIP Play, Inc., a Nevada micro-cap company, disclosed the terms of its First Amended and Restated Discretionary Convertible Revolving Line of Credit Demand Note with Excel Family Partners, LLLP. The note carries a 12% fixed annual interest rate and allows Excel to convert outstanding debt into common stock at 80% of the lowest recent share price within the prior 12 months. As of April 20, 2026, the aggregate outstanding principal balance was $24,500,626 — which exceeds the stated $14,000,000 maximum, an inconsistency not explained in the filing.
corrected_fields.why_it_matters: This is a routine corporate debt disclosure for a micro-cap company. It does not contain information relevant to macroeconomic policy, market structure, or broader market catalysts. The note terms (related-party transaction, demand feature, above-market interest rate, conversion rights with dilution potential) are material only to VIP Play's shareholders and are typical for thinly capitalized companies. Note: The outstanding balance ($24,500,626) exceeds the stated maximum principal ($14,000,000), suggesting either an uncapped facility or undisclosed additional borrowings.
